values: MBAWC (Master Builders Association Western Cape) — Membership Directory
Data scraped from the official MBAWC member API (admin.mbawc.org.za/api/members/) and the public-facing member directory at mbawc.org.za/members. Scraped 22 October 2026.
Full membership directory with 23 fields including trading name, contact details, categories, website, email, membership type, and certificate download link.

Operating-area classification for every member. Locations are derived from the company's postal code using South African Post Office prefix conventions (Western Cape = 6700–8099, Gauteng = 0001–2199, etc.). Companies flagged as 'National' operate nationwide (national insurance, software, cement/ready-mix producers, major banks/insurers, national merchant chains) based on category and company profile.

CA(SA) chartered accountants serving as CFO, Financial Director, or equivalent financial leadership at member companies, with Title, First Name(s), Surname, LinkedIn profile link (where publicly available), and source notes.

0001–0299 Gauteng (Pretoria); 0300–0499 North West; 0500–0999 Limpopo; 1000–2199 Gauteng; 2200–2499 Mpumalanga; 2500–2899 North West; 2900–4799 KwaZulu-Natal; 4800–6699 Eastern Cape; 6700–8099 Western Cape; 8100–8999 Northern Cape; 9300–9999 Free State.

Companies whose categories or name indicate national or multinational operations (e.g. insurance providers, software firms, national cement producers like PPC/AfriSam, JSE-listed groups, national merchant chains). These are highlighted in yellow on the Locations tab.

Focused on CA(SA) (South African Institute of Chartered Accountants) professionals serving as Chief Financial Officer, Financial Director, Head of Finance, or equivalent at MBAWC member companies. Non-CA finance leaders (CIMA, ACCA, etc.) are not listed unless they serve alongside a CA(SA) as a secondary note.

Public information only — CFO South Africa profiles (cfo.co.za), company websites' leadership/team pages, LinkedIn public listings, RocketReach/Zoominfo public snippets, JSE SENS announcements, MarketScreener/Crunchbase executive profiles, and industry news (Engineering News, CFO Awards, Moneyweb, IOL Business).

The MBAWC membership is dominated by SMME contractors (346 members, most being small to medium Western Cape firms). The majority of small contractors, sole proprietors, and labour-only subcontractors do not employ a CA(SA) — their financial function is typically outsourced to an accounting firm or handled by a bookkeeper. Rows without entries are left intentionally blank; they do not necessarily mean no CA(SA) is involved, only that none was publicly findable through open web research. The tab is structured so you can add further entries as you obtain them.
How to get more complete coverage

Options include: (1) purchasing a RocketReach/Lusha/Apollo subscription for LinkedIn-backed employee lookups; (2) searching SAICA's member directory (saica.org.za); (3) cross-referencing CIPC company director disclosures; (4) sending a brief CA(SA) confirmation survey to members.

4 parallel web-intelligence agents running X-ray (site:-operator + targeted) searches across LinkedIn (public profiles), company leadership pages, CFO South Africa profiles, JSE SENS announcements, RocketReach/Zoominfo/Crunchbase public snippets, Engineering News, cfo.co.za, MarketScreener, and company websites.

1. Refreshed all 346 members from the MBAWC API.
2. Prioritised companies by a score (Pty Ltd/Ltd suffix, corporate email domain, website, reg number, membership tenure, category — larger civil/general contractors and national suppliers scored highest).
3. Dispatched parallel agents running X-ray searches for: '<Company> CFO OR "financial director" CA(SA) linkedin'; site:linkedin.com CA(SA) searches; company about/team page discovery; cross-referencing against cfo.co.za profiles and annual-report director disclosures.
4. Agents filtered out recruiters/job postings and only logged entries where the person's name + role + CA(SA) status could be verified from a credible source (company website, SENS, CFO SA profile, LinkedIn headline, annual report).
5. For SMEs where no CA(SA) was found after searching, a note was recorded stating this (these companies typically outsource finance to an accounting practice or employ a non-CA bookkeeper/financial manager).

• Total members searched: 346
• Confirmed CA(SA) financial-leader entries populated: 17 companies
  – with direct LinkedIn profile links: 6
  – with full name, title, and verified credentials but no public LinkedIn found: 11
• Companies where a non-CA finance lead was also noted (for reference): 4 (Enza/Dave Lofthouse; GeoCiv/Desmond Lange; Johnson Crane Hire/Sean Marley; Form-Scaff/Abrie du Toit; Dekon/Annelien Barretti; Boshard/Phindile Sodawe QS; Abbeydale/Clinton Froneman CIMA).
• SMEs / family businesses / small contractors with no publicly identified CA(SA): the great majority of the remaining ~320 companies — rows left blank for manual completion.

• CAs(SA) listed are current (as of 2026) based on public sources; some companies may have made subsequent appointments not yet reflected online.
• LinkedIn profile URLs are public profile slugs visible to search engines; some individuals have privacy settings that hide full details.
• Some large groups list multiple CAs(SA) at subsidiary or board level — only the primary financial leader is in the main columns; additional CAs are noted in the Source/Notes column.
• Entries marked 'CA(SA) not confirmed' are individuals holding the title of CFO/FD whose CA(SA) status could not be verified from public sources — they are included so you can follow up.

• Cross-reference against SAICA's public member register (saica.co.za) using first + last name + company.
• Pull CIPC/CIPRO director disclosures (directorsearch.cipc.co.za) for each company — directors with CA(SA) often appear with their professional designation.
• Run a RocketReach/Apollo/Lusha bulk enrichment with a paid API key on the remaining ~320 companies — those tools return LinkedIn-verified employee data.
• Send a short confirmation survey to the 346 members asking their financial director's name, CA(SA) status, and LinkedIn URL.

Scope correction: The user clarified that ALL CAs(SA) at member companies (not just C-suite/executives) should be listed, including Financial Managers, Controllers, Internal Audit, Divisional Finance, Company Secretaries, etc. at all seniority levels.
